-- AntiBang v3 (client) | K = вкл/выкл | RightShift = скрыть/показать окно
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")

local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
local CFG = {
	Distance = 4, -- студы: банг держит атакующего в 1-2 студах от тебя
	HideTime = 0.6, -- секунд под картой (меньше 0.5 он может не успеть уехать следом)
	Key = Enum.KeyCode.K,
	HideKey = Enum.KeyCode.RightShift,
	Whitelist = {}, -- можно вписать сразу: {"Friend1"}
}

local enabled, busy = true, false
local hits, lastName = 0, "-"
local updateUI = function() end

local function notify(t)
	pcall(function()
		StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {Title = "AntiBang", Text = t, Duration = 2})
	end)
end

local function root(plr)
	local c = plr.Character
	return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function isWhite(name)
	name = name:lower()
	for _, n in ipairs(CFG.Whitelist) do
		if n:lower() == name then return true end
	end
	return false
end

-- ЛОГИКА
local function dive(attacker)
	local me = root(lp)
	if not me then return end
	busy = true
	hits += 1
	lastName = attacker.Name
	updateUI()

	local home = me.CFrame
	local y = workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight + 25
	me.CFrame = CFrame.new(home.X, y, home.Z)
	me.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	me.Anchored = true
	notify(attacker.Name .. " рядом: ушёл под карту")

	task.delay(CFG.HideTime, function()
		local r = root(lp)
		if r then
			r.Anchored = false
			r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			r.CFrame = home
		end
		busy = false
	end)
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not enabled or busy then return end
	local me = root(lp)
	if not me then return end
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if p ~= lp and not isWhite(p.Name) then
			local r = root(p)
			if r and (r.Position - me.Position).Magnitude < CFG.Distance then
				dive(p)
				break
			end
		end
	end
end)

-- GUI
local function mk(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	o.Parent = parent
	return o
end
local function corner(o, r) mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 8)}, o) end

local BG, PANEL, GREEN, RED = Color3.fromRGB(24, 26, 32), Color3.fromRGB(40, 43, 52), Color3.fromRGB(40, 160, 80), Color3.fromRGB(170, 50, 50)

local gui = mk("ScreenGui", {Name = "AntiBangGui", ResetOnSpawn = false}, (gethui and gethui()) or lp:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))
local main = mk("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 280), Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0.3, 0), BackgroundColor3 = BG, BorderSizePixel = 0}, gui)
corner(main, 10)

local title = mk("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32), BackgroundColor3 = PANEL, BorderSizePixel = 0}, main)
corner(title, 10)
mk("TextLabel", {Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "AntiBang", TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 15, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left}, title)
local minBtn = mk("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 24), Position = UDim2.new(1, -34, 0, 4), BackgroundColor3 = BG, Text = "–", TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 16}, title)
corner(minBtn, 6)

local body = mk("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -32), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 32), BackgroundTransparency = 1}, main)
mk("UIPadding", {PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 8), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8)}, body)
mk("UIListLayout", {Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder}, body)

local function label(text, h, order)
	return mk("TextLabel", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, h), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = text, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 205, 215), Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 12, TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, LayoutOrder = order}, body)
end
local function button(text, w, order, parent)
	local b = mk("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.new(w, 0, 0, 28), BackgroundColor3 = PANEL, Text = text, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 13, LayoutOrder = order}, parent or body)
	corner(b, 6)
	return b
end

-- вкл/выкл
local toggleBtn = button("", 1, 1)
toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34)

-- степперы
local function stepper(name, order, key, step, min, max)
	local row = mk("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order}, body)
	mk("TextLabel", {Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = name, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 205, 215), Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 12, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left}, row)
	local minus = mk("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0), BackgroundColor3 = PANEL, Text = "-", TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 16}, row)
	local val = mk("TextLabel", {Size = UDim2.new(0, 44, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 32, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 13}, row)
	local plus = mk("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28), Position = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 0), BackgroundColor3 = PANEL, Text = "+", TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 16}, row)
	corner(minus, 6) corner(plus, 6)
	local function set(v)
		CFG[key] = math.clamp(math.floor(v * 10 + 0.5) / 10, min, max)
		val.Text = tostring(CFG[key])
	end
	minus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() set(CFG[key] - step) end)
	plus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() set(CFG[key] + step) end)
	set(CFG[key])
end
stepper("Дистанция (студы)", 2, "Distance", 1, 2, 30)
stepper("Под картой (сек)", 3, "HideTime", 0.5, 0.5, 5)

-- белый список
local wlRow = mk("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 4}, body)
local box = mk("TextBox", {Size = UDim2.new(1, -66, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = PANEL, PlaceholderText = "ник друга", Text = "", TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 135, 145), Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 12, ClearTextOnFocus = false}, wlRow)
corner(box, 6)
local addBtn = mk("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28), Position = UDim2.new(1, -62, 0, 0), BackgroundColor3 = GREEN, Text = "+", TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 16}, wlRow)
local clrBtn = mk("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28), Position = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 0), BackgroundColor3 = RED, Text = "x", TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 14}, wlRow)
corner(addBtn, 6) corner(clrBtn, 6)

local wlLabel = label("", 34, 5)
local statLabel = label("", 34, 6)

function updateUI()
	toggleBtn.Text = enabled and "ВКЛЮЧЕНО (K)" or "ВЫКЛЮЧЕНО (K)"
	toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = enabled and GREEN or RED
	wlLabel.Text = "Друзья: " .. (#CFG.Whitelist > 0 and table.concat(CFG.Whitelist, ", ") or "нет")
	statLabel.Text = "Срабатываний: " .. hits .. "\nПоследний: " .. lastName
end

local function toggle() enabled = not enabled updateUI() end
toggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggle)

addBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local n = box.Text:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
	if n ~= "" and not isWhite(n) then table.insert(CFG.Whitelist, n) end
	box.Text = ""
	updateUI()
end)
clrBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() CFG.Whitelist = {} updateUI() end)

-- сворачивание
local collapsed = false
minBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	collapsed = not collapsed
	body.Visible = not collapsed
	main.Size = collapsed and UDim2.fromOffset(240, 32) or UDim2.fromOffset(240, 280)
	minBtn.Text = collapsed and "+" or "–"
end)

-- перетаскивание за заголовок (мышь и тач)
do
	local dragging, startPos, startInput
	title.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
		if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging, startPos, startInput = true, main.Position, i.Position
			i.Changed:Connect(function()
				if i.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
			end)
		end
	end)
	UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
		if dragging and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			local d = i.Position - startInput
			main.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
		end
	end)
end

-- горячие клавиши
UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(i, gp)
	if gp then return end
	if i.KeyCode == CFG.Key then toggle()
	elseif i.KeyCode == CFG.HideKey then main.Visible = not main.Visible end
end)

local function isEnemy(plr)
	return plr.Team == nil or plr.Team ~= player.Team
end

local function updateEsp()
	local myChar = player.Character
	local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if plr ~= player then
			local char = plr.Character
			local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local dist = (root and myRoot) and (root.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude or 0

			local show = settings.ESP
				and hum ~= nil
				and root ~= nil
				and hum.Health > 0
				and dist <= settings.MaxDistance
				and (not settings.TeamCheck or isEnemy(plr))

			if show then
				local o = espObjects[plr]
				if o and o.Char ~= char then
					destroyEsp(plr)
					o = nil
				end
				if not o then
					o = createEsp(plr, char)
				end
				if o then
					local color = isEnemy(plr) and theme.enemy or theme.friend
					o.Highlight.FillColor = color
					o.Name.Visible = settings.ShowNames
					o.Name.Text = plr.DisplayName
					o.HealthBg.Visible = settings.ShowHealth
					local hp = math.clamp(hum.Health / math.max(hum.MaxHealth, 1), 0, 1)
					o.HealthFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(hp, 1)
					o.HealthFill.BackgroundColor3 = theme.enemy:Lerp(theme.friend, hp)
					o.Dist.Visible = settings.ShowDistance
					o.Dist.Text = string.format("%d studs", dist)
				end
			else
				destroyEsp(plr)
			end
		end
	end
end

local function isVisible(char, part)
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { player.Character }
	local origin = camera.CFrame.Position
	local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, part.Position - origin, params)
	return result == nil or result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(char)
end

local function getTarget()
	local center = camera.ViewportSize / 2
	local myRoot = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local partName = settings.AimPart == "Head" and "Head" or "HumanoidRootPart"
	local best, bestDist = nil, settings.FOV

	for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if plr ~= player and (not settings.TeamCheck or isEnemy(plr)) then
			local char = plr.Character
			local part = char and (char:FindFirstChild(partName) or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
			local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if part and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
				local inRange = not myRoot or (part.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude <= settings.MaxDistance
				if inRange then
					local screenPos, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
					if onScreen then
						local d = (Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y) - center).Magnitude
						if d < bestDist and (not settings.WallCheck or isVisible(char, part)) then
							best, bestDist = part, d
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function updateAim()
	if not settings.Aim or menuOpen then
		return
	end
	if not UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2) then

	local target = getTarget()
	if target then
		local goal = CFrame.new(camera.CFrame.Position, target.Position)
		camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame:Lerp(goal, settings.Smooth)

		if settings.AutoShoot and os.clock() - lastShot > 0.1 then
			local tool = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
			if tool then
				lastShot = os.clock()
				tool:Activate()
			end
		end
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
RunService:BindToRenderStep("NovaUpdate", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
	camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	camera.FieldOfView = settings.CameraFOV

	fovCircle.Visible = settings.Aim and settings.ShowFOV
	fovCircle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(settings.FOV * 2, settings.FOV * 2)
	fovCircle.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)

	updateEsp()
	updateAim()
end)

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Fly
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local flyWasActive = false

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	local char = player.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not (root and hum) then
		return
	end

	if settings.Fly then
		flyWasActive = true
		hum.PlatformStand = true

		local cf = camera.CFrame
		local dir = Vector3.zero
		if not UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then dir += cf.LookVector end
			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then dir -= cf.LookVector end
			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then dir += cf.RightVector end
			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then dir -= cf.RightVector end
			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then dir += Vector3.yAxis end
			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then dir -= Vector3.yAxis end
		end
		if dir.Magnitude > 0 then
			dir = dir.Unit
		end

		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = dir * settings.FlySpeed
		root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

		local flat = Vector3.new(cf.LookVector.X, 0, cf.LookVector.Z)
		if flat.Magnitude > 0.001 then
			root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + flat)
		end
	elseif flyWasActive then
		flyWasActive = false
		hum.PlatformStand = false
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end
end)

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Noclip
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local noclipWasActive = false
local collidableParts = { "HumanoidRootPart", "Head", "Torso", "UpperTorso", "LowerTorso" }

RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then
		return
	end

	if settings.Noclip then
		noclipWasActive = true
		for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				part.CanCollide = false
			end
		end
	elseif noclipWasActive then
		noclipWasActive = false
		for _, name in ipairs(collidableParts) do
			local part = char:FindFirstChild(name)
			if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
				part.CanCollide = true
			end
		end
	end
end)

toast("Press CTRL to open the menu")

scripts.script:
local WindUI = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://github.com/Footagesus/WindUI/releases/latest/download/main.lua"))()

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local S = {
    AutoSlap = false,
    SlapRange = 15,
    SpamDelay = 0.6,
    InfSlapTool = false,
    RemoteDelay = 0.1,
    SlapAll = false,
    Spin = false,
    SpinSpeed = 20,
    InfJump = false,
    SpeedHack = false,
    SpeedValue = 60,
    BHop = false,
    TrollSomeone = false,
    TrollTarget = nil,
    TrollDelay = 0.6,
}

local BHopSoundId = "rbxassetid://9114890978"
local BHopMax = 150
local BHopMultiplier = 1.3
local BHopResetTime = 0.4

local slapConn = nil
local remoteConn = nil
local slapAllThread = nil
local trollFollowConn = nil
local trollSlapThread = nil
local spinConn = nil
local jumpConn = nil
local speedConn = nil
local bhopConn = nil
local spinAngle = 0
local lastSlap = 0
local bhopSpeed = 16
local lastJumpTime = 0
local jumpSound = nil

local Window = WindUI:CreateWindow({
    Title = "INSANE wallhop tower",
    Icon = "hand",
    Author = "TG: @ventozzz",
    Folder = "InsaneWallHop",
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(500, 540),
    Transparent = true,
    Theme = "Dark",
    Resizable = true,
})

local MainTab = Window:Tab({ Title = "Main", Icon = "hand" })
local MovementTab = Window:Tab({ Title = "Movement", Icon = "wind" })
local TrollTab = Window:Tab({ Title = "Troll", Icon = "troll" })

local remote = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("GetSlap")

local function getGloves()
    local gloves = {}
    local backpack = lp:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
    if backpack then
        for _, item in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
            if item:IsA("Tool") then table.insert(gloves, item) end
        end
    end
    local char = lp.Character
    if char then
        for _, item in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if item:IsA("Tool") then table.insert(gloves, item) end
        end
    end
    return gloves
end

local function equipGlove(glove)
    local char = lp.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end
    if glove and glove.Parent then
        pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(glove) end)
    end
end

local function slapTarget(targetChar)
    if not targetChar then return end
    local myChar = lp.Character
    if not myChar then return end
    local myRoot = myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local tRoot = targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot or not tRoot then return end

    local gloves = getGloves()
    if #gloves == 0 then return end
    equipGlove(gloves[math.random(1, #gloves)])

    RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
    RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()

    local tool = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    if tool then
        pcall(function() tool:Activate() end)
    end

    pcall(function()
        remote:FireServer(targetChar)
    end)
end

local function getNearestPlayer()
    local myRoot = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return nil end
    local best, bestDist = nil, S.SlapRange
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr == lp then continue end
        local char = plr.Character
        if not char then continue end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hum or not root or hum.Health <= 0 then continue end
        local dist = (myRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
        if dist < bestDist then
            best, bestDist = char, dist
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function doSlap()
    local now = tick()
    if now - lastSlap < S.SpamDelay then return end
    lastSlap = now
    local target = getNearestPlayer()
    if not target then return end
    slapTarget(target)
end

local function startAutoSlap()
    if slapConn then slapConn:Disconnect() end
    slapConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not S.AutoSlap then return end
        doSlap()
    end)
end

local function stopAutoSlap()
    if slapConn then slapConn:Disconnect() slapConn = nil end
end

local function startInfSlapTool()
    if remoteConn then pcall(function() task.cancel(remoteConn) end) end
    remoteConn = task.spawn(function()
        while S.InfSlapTool do
            pcall(function() remote:FireServer() end)
            task.wait(S.RemoteDelay)
        end
    end)
end

local function stopInfSlapTool()
    S.InfSlapTool = false
    if remoteConn then
        pcall(function() task.cancel(remoteConn) end)
        remoteConn = nil
    end
end

local function startSpin()
    local char = lp.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then hum.AutoRotate = false end
    spinAngle = 0
    if spinConn then spinConn:Disconnect() end
    spinConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        if not S.Spin then return end
        local c = lp.Character
        if not c then return end
        local root = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then return end
        spinAngle = spinAngle + dt * S.SpinSpeed
        root.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, spinAngle, 0)
    end)
end

local function stopSpin()
    if spinConn then spinConn:Disconnect() spinConn = nil end
    local char = lp.Character
    if char then
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then hum.AutoRotate = true end
    end
end

local function startInfJump()
    if jumpConn then jumpConn:Disconnect() end
    jumpConn = UIS.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
        local char = lp.Character
        if not char then return end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum then return end
        hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
    end)
end

local function stopInfJump()
    if jumpConn then jumpConn:Disconnect() jumpConn = nil end
end

local function startSpeed()
    if speedConn then speedConn:Disconnect() end
    speedConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local char = lp.Character
        if not char then return end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hum or not root then return end
        local md = hum.MoveDirection
        if md.Magnitude < 0.1 then return end
        local dir = Vector3.new(md.X, 0, md.Z).Unit
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(dir.X * S.SpeedValue, root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, dir.Z * S.SpeedValue)
    end)
end

local function stopSpeed()
    if speedConn then speedConn:Disconnect() speedConn = nil end
end

local function playJumpSound()
    if not jumpSound then
        jumpSound = Instance.new("Sound")
        jumpSound.Name = "BHopSound"
        jumpSound.Parent = SoundService
    end
    jumpSound.SoundId = BHopSoundId
    jumpSound.Volume = 1
    jumpSound.PlaybackSpeed = 1
    jumpSound:Play()
end

local function startBHop()
    if bhopConn then bhopConn:Disconnect() end
    bhopSpeed = 16
    lastJumpTime = 0

    bhopConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not S.BHop then return end
        local char = lp.Character
        if not char then return end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hum or not root then return end

        local onGround = hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
        local now = tick()

        if onGround then
            if lastJumpTime > 0 and now - lastJumpTime > BHopResetTime then
                bhopSpeed = 16
            end
            hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
            lastJumpTime = now
            playJumpSound()
        end

        local md = hum.MoveDirection
        if md.Magnitude > 0.1 then
            local dir = Vector3.new(md.X, 0, md.Z).Unit
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
                dir.X * bhopSpeed,
                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.y,
                dir.Z * bhopSpeed
            )
        end

        if not onGround and lastJumpTime > 0 and now - lastJumpTime < BHopResetTime then
            bhopSpeed = bhopSpeed * BHopMultiplier
            if bhopSpeed > BHopMax then bhopSpeed = BHopMax end
            lastJumpTime = 0
        end
    end)
end

local function stopBHop()
    if bhopConn then bhopConn:Disconnect() bhopConn = nil end
    bhopSpeed = 16
    if jumpSound then jumpSound:Stop() end
end

local function startSlapAll()
    if slapAllThread then
        pcall(function() task.cancel(slapAllThread) end)
    end
    slapAllThread = task.spawn(function()
        local endTime = tick() + 8
        while S.SlapAll and tick() < endTime do
            pcall(function() remote:FireServer() end)
            task.wait(0.05)
        end

        while S.SlapAll do
            for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if not S.SlapAll then return end
                if plr == lp then continue end
                local char = plr.Character
                if not char then continue end
                local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then continue end

                local startFollow = tick()
                while S.SlapAll and tick() - startFollow < 1 do
                    local myChar = lp.Character
                    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    local tChar = plr.Character
                    local tRoot = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if myRoot and tRoot then
                        pcall(function() myRoot:SetNetworkOwner(lp) end)
                        local back = tRoot.CFrame.LookVector * -3
                        myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(tRoot.Position + back, tRoot.Position)
                        myRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                        myRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    end
                    RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                end

                if not S.SlapAll then return end

                local gloves = getGloves()
                if #gloves > 0 then
                    equipGlove(gloves[math.random(1, #gloves)])
                    RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                    RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                    local tool = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
                    if tool then
                        pcall(function() tool:Activate() end)
                    end
                    pcall(function() remote:FireServer(char) end)
                end
                task.wait(0.3)
            end
            task.wait(0.3)
        end
    end)
end

local function stopSlapAll()
    S.SlapAll = false
    if slapAllThread then
        pcall(function() task.cancel(slapAllThread) end)
        slapAllThread = nil
    end
end

local function startTrollSomeone()
    if trollFollowConn then trollFollowConn:Disconnect() end
    if trollSlapThread then pcall(function() task.cancel(trollSlapThread) end) end

    trollFollowConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not S.TrollSomeone then return end
        local target = S.TrollTarget
        if not target or not target.Parent then return end
        local char = target.Character
        if not char then return end
        local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local myChar = lp.Character
        local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root or not myRoot then return end

        pcall(function() myRoot:SetNetworkOwner(lp) end)
        local back = root.CFrame.LookVector * -3
        myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position + back, root.Position)
        myRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        myRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end)

    trollSlapThread = task.spawn(function()
        while S.TrollSomeone do
            task.wait(S.TrollDelay)
            if not S.TrollSomeone then return end
            local target = S.TrollTarget
            if not target or not target.Parent then continue end
            local char = target.Character
            if not char then continue end
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then continue end
            slapTarget(char)
        end
    end)
end

local function stopTrollSomeone()
    S.TrollSomeone = false
    if trollFollowConn then trollFollowConn:Disconnect() trollFollowConn = nil end
    if trollSlapThread then
        pcall(function() task.cancel(trollSlapThread) end)
        trollSlapThread = nil
    end
end

local selectedPlayerName = nil

local playerDropdown = TrollTab:Dropdown({
    Title = "Troll Player",
    Values = {},
    Multi = false,
    Default = "",
    Callback = function(selected)
        selectedPlayerName = selected
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr.Name == selected then
                S.TrollTarget = plr
                break
            end
        end
    end
})

TrollTab:Button({
    Title = "Refresh Player List",
    Callback = function()
        local names = {}
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr ~= lp then
                table.insert(names, plr.Name)
            end
        end
        if #names == 0 then names = { "no players" } end
        pcall(function()
            playerDropdown:Refresh(names)
        end)
    end
})

TrollTab:Toggle({
    Title = "Troll Player",
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        S.TrollSomeone = v
        if v then startTrollSomeone() else stopTrollSomeone() end
    end
})

TrollTab:Slider({

})

MainTab:Toggle({

    Callback = function(v)

        if v then startAutoSlap() else stopAutoSlap() end
    end
})

MainTab:Slider({

MainTab:Slider({

MainTab:Toggle({
